name: sc5314_haploid
key_challenge: Paralog gene families, heterozygosity baseline (simpler haploid control)

reference.notes: Haploid representation for baseline comparison. Use sc5314_diploid for heterozygosity and LOH testing.

download.command: datasets download genome accession GCF_000182965.3 --include genome --filename ncbi_dataset.zip && unzip -o ncbi_dataset.zip && cat ncbi_dataset/data/GCF_000182965.3/*.fna > reference.fasta && rm -rf ncbi_dataset ncbi_dataset.zip

simulation.command: dwgsim -1 150 -2 150 -C 50 -z {rng_seed} ../reference/reference.fasta reads && mv reads.bwa.read1.fastq.gz reads_1.fastq.gz && mv reads.bwa.read2.fastq.gz reads_2.fastq.gz

truth.simulated: dwgsim read name encodes true origin coordinates; evaluate with paftools.js mapeval

benchmark_notes: Use alongside sc5314_diploid to isolate the contribution of heterozygosity to aligner behavior. 8 chromosome pairs.
